name: hayabusa
description: Fast Windows event log forensics and threat hunting tool that parses .evtx files with Sigma-based detection rules

install_steps: Download the hayabusa release zip for your platform from https://github.com/Yamato-Security/hayabusa/releases and extract the binary to PATH

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install hayabusa: download the release zip from https://github.com/Yamato-Security/hayabusa/releases

commands.description: Generate a consolidated CSV timeline from .evtx files (hayabusa csv-timeline -d ./evtx -o out.csv). Add -l to live-analyze the current system

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install hayabusa: download the release zip from https://github.com/Yamato-Security/hayabusa/releases

commands.description: Generate a JSON/JSONL timeline from .evtx files (hayabusa json-timeline -d ./evtx -o out.json -L). Best for piping into jq or SIEMs

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install hayabusa: download the release zip from https://github.com/Yamato-Security/hayabusa/releases

commands.description: Print event ID counts and percentages per .evtx file (hayabusa log-metrics -d ./evtx). Quick overview before deep analysis

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install hayabusa: download the release zip from https://github.com/Yamato-Security/hayabusa/releases

commands.description: Keyword/regex search inside .evtx event data (hayabusa search -d ./evtx -k mimikatz). Add -o for output file, -F for field filters

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install hayabusa: download the release zip from https://github.com/Yamato-Security/hayabusa/releases

commands.description: Update bundled Sigma detection rules to the latest version (hayabusa update-rules)
